Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ela Eshin: 19-year-old woman, 154 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-2-light. Face: soft rectangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, long-loose, deliberate accent: one bound side fall. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive patchwork of ordinary ink marks across the arms and upper back; a small throat necklace. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
